title: Tome
subtitle: A book on its side
description: A book seen from the front, turned ninety degrees, with a flat spine notched at its head and tail and a rounded fore-edge.
The notches are the codex cue: one straight side and one round side is a shape, not a book, and at node size the old outline read as a D-pad button as often as a tome.

The turn rotates the shape's own definition rather than re-sampling its pixels, and the turned outline is fitted to the node with one uniform scale -- nothing is cut off at the node's edge and nothing is stretched. The icon stays upright in the middle of it, in the largest square that fits the turned outline.
